conbody.p: The message will appear when the system is not functioning normally. The system will be canceled and the word AUTO on the cluster will disappear and instead display regenerative braking level. Check for foreign substances on the front radar. Remove any dirt, snow, or foreign material that could interfere with the radar sensors. If the system still does not operate normally, have your vehicle inspected by a professional workshop. Kia recommends visiting an authorized Kia dealer or service partner.
